title: Varying trace square on any single system object
statement:
Let $l$ be prime, $E$ a finite dimensional extension field of $\mathbf Q_l$, $f:X\to S$ a morphism of schemes with diagonal localizations, and $p$ a presentation [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation]. Assume that for every K-injective complex $I$ of varying coefficient systems on $X$, $\eta_t(r_X I)$ is invertible. For every system object $M$ on $X$, the presentation's varying comparison satisfies DiagonalSingleSquare [lem-sfb-diagonal-trace-varying-full-normalization]:
\[D(r_S)(\rho_F(M))\,v_{s_XM}\,R_t(s_{r_X}(M))=s_{r_S}(FM)\,s_S(v^{\mathrm{ord}}_M)\,\rho_t(r_XM).\]
Here $F$ is the ordinary geometric pushforward, $\rho_F$ is formed with its canonical right derived functor [lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived], $s_{r_T}$ is the exact restriction's single-object comparison, $\rho_t$ is the ordinary-to-derived single-object arrow for constant-scalar pushforward, and composition is in application order.

proof.text: Use the stated acyclicity to extend the supplied normalization on K-injectives to the full cochain-unit normalization.
Evaluate the full normalization on the specified system object in degree zero. Naturality of exact single-functor comparisons and the cochain units gives the equality defined by DiagonalSingleSquare.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_varying_single_square
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l E f)
    (hacyc : ∀ I : CochainComplex (SpTowerClasses.Systems X
      (SpTowerClasses.Arings l E X)) ℤ, I.IsKInjective →
      IsIso (p.Rt.η.app ((p.restrictionX.F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
    (M : SpTowerClasses.Systems X (SpTowerClasses.Arings l E X)) :
    let := p.base.kinjective X
    let := p.model.geometry.pushAdditive
    let := p.restrictionS.additive
    let := p.restrictionX.additive
    let := p.restrictionX.limits
    let := p.restrictionX.colimits
    let := p.restrictionS.limits
    let := p.restrictionS.colimits
    DiagonalSingleSquare p.model.geometry.push (diagonalTraceSystemPush l f)
      p.restrictionX.F p.restrictionS.F (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived p.model.geometry.push)
      p.Rt p.varyingOrdinary p.varying M
